title: Kitty's Hungry Adventure
description:
In Kitty's Hungry Adventure, you will help Kitty prepare the best dishes while navigating platform levels, collecting shiny stones and outfits, and solving puzzles.

Key Features:

Hardcore gameplay with platformer elements.

Numerous levels with various dangers and puzzles.

Collect stones and outfits for Kitty.

A unique dish-cooking system.

A pleasant and cozy atmosphere with vibrant design.
description_short: Kitty's Hungry Adventure is a hardcore cozy platformer about Kitty’s adventures as she tries to cook the most delicious dishes while overcoming dangers and solving puzzles.
